editorial_review.visual_truth: All original eight Wikimedia Commons preview strips and 13 decoded output frames at 1,3,6,9,12,15,18,21,24,27,30,33,36 seconds inspected. The eight separate source clips depict greater flamingos in wetland/shallow water, not invented feeding events. The information about carotenoids and bill filtration is sourced biology; it does not claim footage reveals microscopic lamellae or gray chicks.
editorial_review.limitations: Birds in several long wetland shots are relatively distant and small; at least the 21-24s section has a larger identifiable flamingo. Large blurred portrait matte occupies spare frame space. No false species labels or fabricated closeup; acceptable as illustrative documentary rather than direct microscopic proof. Vary original sources in future batches for closer details.
